name: Nosuri
source: A girl who leads a clan of thieves titled after her name, the Nosuri Thieves. She is a lively thief who has a big chest and is not very well organized. She has a penchant for the dramatic, and her younger brother [url=/c37797]Ougi[/url] can eternally be found at her side, facilitating her grandiose schemes.
